_meta.purpose_ja: `Fetch Holidays`（Google Calendar ノード v1.3、Event → Get Many、Calendar By ID = ja.japanese#holiday@group.v.calendar.google.com、After/Before = 当日の ISO 範囲）の pinned data。P3 で `PATCH /rest/workflows/{id}` の pinData["Fetch Holidays"] にそのまま入れる（ASSUMPTIONS A5 / A11）。
_meta.purpose_en: Pinned data for `Fetch Holidays` (Google Calendar node v1.3, Event → Get Many, Calendar By ID = ja.japanese#holiday@group.v.calendar.google.com, After / Before = the day's ISO range). Store it as pinData["Fetch Holidays"] via `PATCH /rest/workflows/{id}` in P3 (ASSUMPTIONS A5 / A11).
shape_sources: n8n Google Calendar node, Event operations → Get Many (Calendar By ID, Return All / Limit, After / Before, Options): https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/builtin/app-nodes/n8n-nodes-base.googlecalendar/event-operations.md (fetched 2026-09-23). The doc points to the API reference below for the item shape.

Google Calendar API, Events resource representation (kind, etag, id, status, htmlLink, created, updated, summary, description, creator{email,displayName,self}, organizer{…}, start{date|dateTime,timeZone}, end{…}, transparency, visibility, iCalUID, sequence, eventType, …): https://developers.google.com/calendar/api/v3/reference/events (fetched 2026-09-23). All-day events carry `start.date` / `end.date` (end is exclusive: the next day).

n8n-nodes-base 2.40.2 GoogleCalendar.node.js (local n8n-runtime, read 2026-09-23): `getAll` returns `responseData.items` one item per event via returnJsonArray; with typeVersion >= 1.3 the item keys are re-ordered by sortItemKeysByPriorityList(['id','summary','start','end','attendees','creator','organizer','description','location','created','updated']) — hence the key order below; on failure with Continue On Fail the item is `{ "error": error.message }` (no `(item N)` suffix, unlike Gmail).
_meta.values_note: Event ids, etags, htmlLinks and timestamps are illustrative. The real Google holiday calendar delivers the same fields (id / iCalUID formats differ). DESIGN.md §8.3-1: P2 captures one real `Fetch Holidays` output and updates this file if the shape differs.

how_to_use.holiday (U09): pin `holiday_2026-09-21` and set Config TODAY_OVERRIDE=2026-09-21 → Check Business Day: reason=holiday, holiday_name=敬老の日, holiday_source=calendar → Skip Non-Business Day
how_to_use.holiday (2026-10-12): pin `holiday_2026-10-12` with TODAY_OVERRIDE=2026-10-12 (スポーツの日, a Monday) — same path, second sample
how_to_use.no holiday (U01 …): pin `none` — the shape Always Output Data produces when the API returns items: [] (one empty item)
how_to_use.API failure (U12): pin `error` — the shape On Error = Continue (regular output) produces; Check Business Day falls back to HOLIDAYS with warning holiday_calendar_unavailable
how_to_use.node deactivated (U22): do NOT pin; deactivate the node instead — a disabled node passes its input (the Resolve Run Date item) through (ASSUMPTIONS A36)
